items.author: vivianrose.bsky.social
items.context: how do y'all feel about meta games? as in, games that hook into or directly tie into other games for you to play em. stuff like archipelago, gamedle or i saw an upcoming one on steam called the pyramid. very curious if there's more of this type of thing
items.text: Archipelago is a great example. It shuffles items from several different games into one shared run, so something you find in your game can unlock progress in a friend's.
